Commentary.Commentary: That's it from us for this game. Do join us for the final game between the two sides on March 12, 2017 at 1400 local (0830 GMT). Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Afghanistan skipper, Asghar Stanikzai says that the series win was very important for them. Credits his bowlers for their performance today. Applauds Karim Janat and Rashid Khan for their brilliant bowling. Ends by saying that they hope to end the series with another win.

Ireland skipper, William Porterfield thinks the rain break cost them the game and calls it frustrating. Accepts that they never got going after it. Was pleased that they set it up well but is disappointed that they did not manage to finish it. Credits Rashid for bowling well as his batsmen failed to pick him. Hopes that they comeback strongly in the upcoming games.

Man of the Match is shared between Rashid Khan and Najeeb Tarakai. Rashid Khan thanks the almighty for his brilliant performance. Says that it was difficult to comeback from the condition they were in before the rain interval but he trusted himself to do it. Says that it was difficult to grip the ball in the start but after the first over he could manage it well.

Ireland will know they messed up a really good chance to stay alive in the series. They got a great start due to Stirling but post the rain break, the batsmen did not apply themselves and failed to find an answer to the spin and guile of Rashid.

Afghanistan will be delighted with the game, it extends their T20I winning streak to 10, a world record already. They did well with the bat with Tarakai striking 90. He got good support from the likes of Nabi and Janat. They did not begin well with the ball but came back superbly thanks to Rashid Khan.

Rain halted play for a long time, when they returned, the equation seemed to be in favour of the visitors needing 46 runs from 29 balls with eight wickets in hand. What followed next though, was mayhem with Rashid Khan running through the side taking his maiden T20I five-wicket haul.

Chasing a score of 185, Ireland lost Stuart Thompson early but Paul Stirling got stuck into the Afghan bowlers, smacking a 15-ball 34 with four towering sixes. The cameo put Ireland ahead of the game with the rain coming down. Eventually he was castled by Karim Janat.

Phew! What a turnaround in the game! Ireland were 12 runs ahead of the D/L par score when rains intervened but Afghanistan roared back in the game, taking as many as seven wickets for just 28 runs to win the game and the series.

NOT OUT! Afghanistan win by 17 runs by D/L method. Bowls it wide outside off, Mulder reaches to it somehow and slogs it wide of long on. They run the first comfortably and the call for the second. Najibullah Zadran who is at long on collects it well and has a shy at the striker's end. He hits and the umpires go upstairs to check for a run out. Hardly matters but still a job to complete. Replays show that the batsman was just in time and they safely complete two runs.
Third umpire referred for a run out appeal at the striker's end. That looks not out.
Outside off, Dockrell eases it down towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Good shot but too late! Fuller into the stumps, Dockrell smacks it over the bowler's head through the mid on region for a boundary.
Mulder clips it towards short fine leg for a single.
Too wide outside off, Mulder tries to make room for him on the leg side which makes it difficult for him to reach it.

NOT OUT! Fuller delivery into the stumps, Mulder smacks it down the ground towards long on. He wants the strike and he calls for a second. The player for long has a shy at the non-striker's end and hits. The umpires go upstairs to check a run out on Dockrell. Replays show that he got in just in time.
There is a run out appeal against Dockrell. Looks not out.
Mohammad Nabi comes on for the final over.

Same delivery like last ball, outside off, Mulder shuffles way outside off and tries to go for the scoop. He misses the ball and so does the keeper. The players run a bye. Unlucky to not get his Hat-Trick here.
Jacob Mulder is the last man in. Rashid is on a Hat Trick!

OUT! Rashid gets his maiden fifer! Another googly just outside off, McCarthy comes across and goes for the conventional sweep. He is unable to make contact and the ball raps him on his pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger to approve it. This young lad has turned the tide completely.
Barry McCarthy is the penultimate man in.

OUT! Rashid is running through the Irishmen! Another wrong 'un but this time in the line of the stumps. Thompson dances down the track and goes for a biggie. He misses it completely and the ball has gone through to the keeper. Shahzad collects it and dislodges the bails in some style. Thompson has to go back to the hut. Afghanistan need two more wickets.
Floated outside off, Thompson fails to connect the sweep this time.
Quicker one outside off, Thompson goes for the reverse sweep but misses.
George Dockrell comes in to bat.

OUT! One more bites the dust! Floated outside off, Tucker gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it straight towards long on. Najibullah Zadran makes no mistake and goes a bit forward to take a fine catch. Ireland have only 3 wickets left and are going down rather quickly.
In the air....safe! Fuller delivery outside off, Tucker throws his bat at it and gets it towards mid on. The ball goes one bounce to the fielder there and the batsmen run a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Thompson pushes it through covers for a single.
Angling into the pads, Tucker tries to clip it on the leg side but misses. The ball hits him low on the pads and they run a leg bye.
FOUR! Lucky! Back of a length delivery outside off, Tucker dances down the track and throws his bat at it. The ball flies off the outside edge through the third man region for a boundary.
FOUR! Good shot! Full outside off, Tucker manages to drag this one over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Greg Thompson strides out to bat.

OUT! Another wicket falls! Angling into the stumps from a length, Andrew McBrine goes for a slog but does not collect well. The fielder at mid-wicket gets it straight towards him. Nabi makes no mistake and pounces on it. Ireland are losing the plot here.
Floated a wrong 'un outside off, Tucker goes for a reverse sweep but misses. He gets rapped on his pads.
Lorcan Tucker comes out to bat.

OUT! Shahzad turns into Flash! Slider outside off, Wilson tries to push at it but gets beaten by the spin. He steps out a bit and Shahzad steps up to the occasion and pulls off a stumping really quickly and appeals. The umpire goes upstairs to check for it. Replays show that Shahzad was really quick to dislodge the bails and Wilson could not bring his back leg back in time.
Is Gary Wilson stumped or is he bowled? Rashid Khan is not sure but Mohammad Shahzad was celebrating the wicket. Let's see.
Tossed outside off, McBrine cuts it through point for a single.
Andrew McBrine comes out to bat.

OUT! Rashid Khan strikes! Floated a wrong 'un just outside off, Kevin O'Brien kneels down and goes for a slog sweep. Totally misses the line and misreads the spin. The ball goes through his gate and straight into the timber. Ireland are in trouble now and they have lost two wickets in two overs.
Wide outside off, Wilson cuts it through the point region for a single.
Full delivery around off, Kevin slog sweeps it towards long on for a single.
Rashid Khan comes in for a bowl.
Gary Wilson makes his way to the middle.

OUT! Change of momentum? Karim bowls it around middle and off, William looks to make room for himself and go over extra cover but finds Rashid Khan at extra cover, who leaps and takes the catch towards his right. Ireland need 43 more in 24 balls.
Caught on the Free Hit! Fuller outside off, Kevin looks to go over extra cover but finds Nabi at sweeper cover. A single taken.
Free hit coming up...
No ball! Slower one gone wrong, it is a waist high full toss, KOB ducks under it. The bowler knows it slipped out and apologizes right away, signaled a no ball.
The total is now competitive as there are still more than four overs left in this contest.
Fuller outside off, Kevin looks to go downtown over long on but gets an inside edge onto his pads.  Every dot ball brings the hosts back in the game.
Fuller on the stumps, William heaves it towards mid on for a single.
Fuller and on leg, William fails to clip it through. The bowler appeals long and hard but that was never going to be out.

1735 local time - The players are heading out to the middle. Ireland need 46 more runs from 29 balls. Ireland are not going to mind this one bit. Afghanistan will know they are up against it. Kevin O'Brien and William Porterfield are out to bat. Karim Janat to complete his over.
1720 local time update - Good news, looks like we may get lucky with a few overs as the rain has relented and the covers have been taken off.

1615 local time update - It was always on the cards! The rain is here, the covers are on the field now! Ireland are ahead in the DLS method calculation. The par score right now was 53 and they are past it. Let's hope the rain clears and we get a full game. Stay tuned for all the action.
On a length on off, tucked through square leg for a single.
Floats it outside off, William looks to work it wide of mid on but finds the fielder. The rain is getting heavier.
Clips one through mid on for a single. Ireland are way ahead of DLS par score at the moment.
Shorter on the stumps, Morgan goes back and punches it through covers for a single.
Outside off, pushed through mid off for a quick single by KOB.

How is that not out? Lands it outside off, William looks to sweep but misses and is hit on his pads. The bowler appeals long and hard but nothing from the umpire. That looked pretty plumb but the umpire gives it a run.
Bowls it on the pads, William fails to clip it through.
Mohammad Nabi comes on for a bowl.
Kevin O'Brien comes out to bat.

OUT! Gone through the gate! Length delivery angling in from outside off, Stirling swings across the line and misses the ball completely. It goes on to hit the timber and Stirling has to make the long way back to the pavilion. Afghanistan needed this wicket desperately.
Fuller delivery outside off, Stirling drives it down the ground towards the fielder at mid off.

Leg bye! Full delivery down the leg side, Porterfield fails to clip it and he gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire denies it as the ball was way down the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
Length delivery outside off, Porterfield drives this one towards covers.
50-run stand up between Porterfield and Stirling!
SIX! Over the ropes! Short delivery just outside off, Potterfield stays deep in his crease and pulls it over the mid-wicket region for a maximum. These guys are going on a very quick pace.
FOUR! LUCKY! Fuller length delivery around off, Porterfield tries to play it down th ground but he gets a thick outside edge to it. The ball runs through the vacant slip region for a boundary.
Karim Janat brought on for a bowl.

SIX! Smoked! Back of a length, down the leg side. Stirling stays deep in his crease and pulls it brutally over the backward square leg region for a maximum. 18 runs off the last over. Par score at the end off 5 overs is 40 runs and Ireland are way past it.
Short outside off, Stirling punches it through covers. the fielders there made a mockery there as the ball went through them. The batsmen run a couple.
Long on in place now.
Another slower one angling across, Stirling fails to read the change of pace as he tries to slog it again. That ball was really close to the stumps.
Slower delivery outside off, Stirling dances down the track and goes for a smack again but misses this time.
SIX! Brilliant! Back of a length delivery angling across, Stirling makes room for himself and hammers it over the long on region for a maximum. He is looking really dangerous.

FOUR! Top shot! Around the leg stick, Stirling heaves it through the square leg region for a boundary. They are on the charge as the rain is coming down. DLS method might come in play after five overs.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SIX! Short delivery into the stumps, Stirling camps back and pulls it powerfully over the mid-wicket region for a maximum.
Tossed outside off, Stirling pushes it towards the cover fielder.
SIX! BRUTAL! Floated outside off, Stirling stays in his crease, gets his front leg out of the way and clobbers it over the mid-wicket region for a biggie.
Angling into the stumps, Porterfield punches it towards mid on for a single.
WIDE! Down the leg side! Porterfield tries to clip it but misses. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Slight drizzle in the air....
Spinning in from the line of the stumps, Stirling tries to clip it on the leg side but manages to get a leading edge through covers for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Porterfield punches it towards covers. The fielder lets it go through his legs and the batsmen run a couple.
Length delivery outside off, Porterfield cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
SIX! WRISTY! Angling into the pads, Porterfield flicks that delivery over the square leg region for a maximum to get off the mark in some style.
William Porterfield is the next man in.
OUT! Shapoor Zadran strikes! Good length delivery outside off, Thompson cuts it straight to the fielder at point. Najibullah Zadran takes a fine catch and Thompson has to walk back to the hut.
FOUR! Length delivery angling into the body, Thompson uses his crease well and smacks it over the mid on region for a boundary.
Angling across from a good length. Paul stays in his crease and guides it towards third man for a single with an angled bat.
Shapoor Zadran to bowl from the other end.
Outside off, Stirling punches it through cover-point for a single.
Full on the pads, Thompson clips it down the ground for a single towards mid on.
DROPPED! Floated outside off, Thomspon thumps it straight to the fielder at mid off. Asghar Stanikzai cannot hold onto a simple catch coming his way. Thompson gets a life really early.
Spinning in from down the leg side, Thompson goes for a sweep but fails to make contact. He gets rapped on his pads and the players appeal. The umpire says no as it was pitched outside leg.
Tossed up outside off, Thompson stays deep in his crease and defends it on the off side.
Angling into the stumps, Thompson defends it towards the mid-wicket fielder.
The players are back in the middle for the chase. Paul Stirling and Stuart Thompson will open the batting for Ireland. Spin to start with from Afghanistan. Amir Hamza will bowl the first over.
